projects.title: ORBIS — AI-Powered Career & Financial Intelligence Platform
projects.description: Built an AI-driven platform helping students choose between Abroad, Government, and Private career paths with data-backed ROI modeling. Implemented Admission Probability Score, Visa Success Estimate, Loan Risk Simulation, and Neural AI Avatar.

projects.title: Life.OS — Emotional Memory Operating System
projects.description: Designed a futuristic personal memory vault with emotional analytics — Happiness Ratio, Growth Momentum, and Stability Index. Built cinematic Memory Replay Mode with life chapter organization.

projects.title: HMS — Hospital Management System
projects.description: Full-stack hospital management system with role-based authentication (Admin, Doctor, Patient). Modules include Patient Records, Doctor Directory, Appointment Booking, Bed Management, and Lab tracking.
